What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number hasn’t updated for several days, this can still be normal. Couriers sometimes delay scans after the label is created, during busy periods, or due to system backlogs. 
What you can do:
Wait a few days after shipment for the first scan to appear.
Check the tracking link regularly on the courier’s official tracking page.
If there are still no updates after 3–5 business days, contact the courier directly using the tracking number to ask about the delay.
Tracking updates often appear once the package reaches the next courier facility.
